dashboard.excursionNoVerificada: Critical excursion of unverified origin: {{temperatura}} °C ({{fecha}}). Check the refrigerator with the backup thermometer.
dashboard.veredictoOkVarios: All {{n}} units are within the 2–8 °C range.

dashboard.causaSinRiesgo: Its status couldn't be worked out. Check it with the backup thermometer.

alertas.sinRevisadas: There are no alerts marked as reviewed.
alertas.sinAtendidas: There are no alerts with a recorded action.
alertas.errorCargar: We couldn't load alerts. Try again.
alertas.errorTabla: Alerts are hidden because we couldn't load the information.
alertas.rectificarAyuda: The original action is not modified: a new version is added with its reason.
alertas.motivoRectificacionAyuda: 10 to 500 characters. It stays in the history next to the correction.

errorRectificacion.conflicto: Someone already amended this action. The timeline was refreshed.
errorRectificacion.prohibido: Only the action's author or a pharmacist can amend it.

alertas.descripcionAccionAyuda: Describe what was done in response to the alert. It will appear in the history.
alertas.incidentesOperativosDetalle: Missing node data and, during a compromise credential rotation, suspended monitoring or unverified-origin excursions. They are not the recorded thermal alerts.
alertas.historicaAyuda: Detected from deferred readings in the node's buffer: the excursion happened before they arrived.

trazabilidad.errorCargar: We could not load the records.
trazabilidad.descripcion: Check whether anyone changed a reading after it was saved.
trazabilidad.cadenaIntegraDetalle_one: We checked <n></n> record and it hasn't changed since it was saved.
trazabilidad.cadenaIntegraDetalle_other: We checked <n></n> records and none has changed since it was saved.
trazabilidad.cadenaRota_one: One record doesn't match: review it
trazabilidad.cadenaRotaDetalle: A difference was detected in record #{{n}}. Notify the administrator and keep the information for review.
trazabilidad.cadenaRotaRegistro: It is the “{{evento}}” record from {{fecha}} at {{hora}}. Notify the administrator and keep the information for review.
trazabilidad.cadenaExplicacion: We compare each reading with what was saved the first time: if anything changed later, we tell you.
trazabilidad.selloAyuda: Technical detail about the record's cryptographic verification
trazabilidad.cadenaComprometida: An inconsistency was detected in the history
trazabilidad.cadenaComprometidaDetalle: Review the flagged record and retain the information for investigation.
trazabilidad.rupturaAislada: An altered record was set aside
trazabilidad.rupturaAisladaDetalle_one: An administrator set aside {{count}} altered record. Everything matches since {{fecha}}.
trazabilidad.rupturaAisladaDetalle_other: An administrator set aside {{count}} altered records. Everything matches since {{fecha}}.
trazabilidad.discrepancia_payload_alterado: Content modified after it was recorded
trazabilidad.discrepancia_enlace_roto: Link to the previous record is broken
trazabilidad.alcanceVerificacion: This check only certifies that stored records were not altered after creation and, if a break exists, where it occurred. It is not a sanitary, regulatory or DIGEMID compliance certification of how the medicines were stored.
trazabilidad.confirmarAislar: This record will be marked as isolated and excluded from the verifiable chain. The action is audited and cannot be undone.
trazabilidad.hastaOpcional: Optional. Leave blank to check through now.
trazabilidad.rangoInvalido: The selected range is invalid: "from" cannot be later than "to".
trazabilidad.segmentoIntegro: No changes detected in this period
trazabilidad.segmentoRoto: A change was detected in this period
trazabilidad.advertenciaSimple: It detects later changes, but it does not prove the original reading was correct, and anyone with the key could recalculate the records.
trazabilidad.advertenciaSello: It detects later changes. It does not prove the physical reading was true, and anyone with the key and write access could recalculate the chain: the seal is evidence, not absolute immutability.

usuarios.errorDuplicado: A user with that email already exists.
usuarios.confirmarDesactivar: Deactivate {{nombre}}? They will no longer be able to sign in, and their identity will be hidden in reports (right to be forgotten, Law No. 29733). The audit trail remains intact.

dispositivos.descripcion: How your refrigerators and cold rooms are doing, how long they stay calibrated and their full record.
dispositivos.confirmarBaja: Decommission device {{id}}? The reading and traceability history remains intact.
dispositivos.instalacionAviso: A location change is recorded in the history; the previous location is not lost.
dispositivos.responsableAviso: This contact receives critical excursion alerts by email and, if the SMS channel is enabled, by text message.
dispositivos.registroAyuda: The code identifies the device in every reading. It must be unique and does not change if you replace a sensor.
dispositivos.codigoUnicoAyuda: Use letters, numbers and hyphens. It appears in every reading.
dispositivos.equipoRegistrado: Device registered with its credential. Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
dispositivos.credencialRevocada: Credential revoked: the system no longer accepts readings from this node. With EMQX Serverless, also remove its user in the console.
dispositivos.simulacionSoloDemo: {{id}} · Local sample scenarios. No ESP32, MQTT, or EMQX connection is made.
dispositivos.motivoCredencialAyuda: Recorded in the audit log (max. 200 characters).
dispositivos.rotarCredencialDescripcion: A new token will be issued for {{id}} and the previous one will stop working.
dispositivos.revocarCredencialDescripcion: Revoke the MQTT credential of {{id}}? The device loses access until it receives a new credential.
dispositivos.tokenAdvertencia: Copy it now and flash it to the node: it will not be shown again and the system only keeps its hash.
dispositivos.sesionBrokerCerrada: The broker closed the device's previous session.
dispositivos.sesionBrokerNoCerrada: The broker did not confirm closing the previous session: check EMQX.
dispositivos.sesionBrokerSinApi: Broker API not configured: the previous session will end when the device reconnects.
dispositivos.codigoInvalido: Invalid code: use only letters, numbers, hyphen or underscore (max. 50).
dispositivos.mesesVigenciaAyuda: The next calibration date is calculated from the date and the validity (1 to 60 months).

confirmarBrokerDescripcion.aprovisionar: Confirm that you created or updated user {{id}} with the current token in the EMQX console.
confirmarBrokerDescripcion.retirar: Confirm that you removed user {{id}} from the EMQX console.

dispositivos.brokerConfirmado: Broker operation confirmed and recorded in the audit log.
dispositivos.telemetriaRetenidaAyuda: Compromise rotation: readings from this device are not recorded until the console is confirmed and the node proves it holds the new credential. The node keeps them and resends them afterwards; meanwhile, a reading outside 2-8 °C raises an unverified-origin alert.

causasRotacion.compromiso: Compromise (the previous token may have leaked)

causaRotacionAyuda.preventiva: The device keeps reporting while the broker console is updated.
causaRotacionAyuda.compromiso: From the rotation on, the system holds this device's telemetry: whoever has the previous token cannot submit readings. Retention ends when, with the console confirmed, the node proves it holds the new credential; it then resends what it kept.

dispositivos.posesionPendienteAyuda: Console confirmed. Retention ends when the node signs the challenge with the new credential; if the console was not changed, the node cannot do so and retention continues.
dispositivos.reenviarDesafioAyuda: After fixing the password in the console: kicks the node session so it reconnects with the new credential and resends the challenge.
dispositivos.desafioReenviado: Challenge resent: the node will reconnect and must prove the new credential.
dispositivos.registroCredencialAviso: Registering issues its credential. It is shown only once.
dispositivos.sinDispositivosAyuda: Register the first one to start receiving readings.
dispositivos.errorCargar: The devices could not be loaded.

metricasIA.descripcion: Review examples of how the model assigns a risk level to each reading.
metricasIA.resumenTitulo: What it is and how it did
metricasIA.definicionF1: Summarizes how the model identifies situations and avoids incorrect classifications, considering the number of cases in each group.
metricasIA.avisoDatosNoReportables: Illustrative sample with synthetic data. It does not prove how it would really perform.
metricasIA.contextoNoVerificado: The data origin still has to be confirmed. Not compared with the threshold.
metricasIA.contextoUmbral: The prototype criterion is {{umbral}} or higher. This result does not show the refrigerator's current status.
metricasIA.definicionExactitud: Share of evaluated cases the model classified correctly.
metricasIA.definicionDeteccionCritica: Share of actual critical excursion cases identified by the model.
metricasIA.notaEvaluacion: These are results of a model test. They are not temperature readings or what happens in your pharmacy.
metricasIA.porClaseAyuda: Compare how each risk level was classified in the evaluated cases.
metricasIA.definicionesTabla: Precision: of the cases the model assigned to a situation, how many matched. Detection: of the actual cases in that situation, how many it identified. F1 summarizes both measures. Cases evaluated is the count used for each row.
metricasIA.comoSeEvaluoAyuda: The average uses {{folds}} data partitions separated by scenario.
metricasIA.agrupacionAyuda: Each partition groups readings by scenario to compare performance.
metricasIA.particionMuestrasValor: {{entrenamiento}} to train the model · {{prueba}} to evaluate it
metricasIA.variablesAyuda: Importance reported for each variable; these details follow the results.
metricasIA.notaImportancias: The percentage compares importance reported for each variable. It does not, on its own, indicate a cause or the probability of a situation.
metricasIA.notaReproducibilidad: These details help identify the evaluation. A random seed or fingerprint alone does not guarantee that training can be repeated exactly.
metricasIA.notaUsoProfesional: To handle an alert, follow your pharmacy's procedure. This result does not replace professional review.
metricasIA.noEntrenado: No evaluation is available for this model yet. Contact the administrator to review its setup.
metricasIA.errorCarga: We couldn't load the model results. Try again.
metricasIA.reglaIndependiente: Random Forest classifies Normal or Preventive risk. A critical excursion is confirmed by the independent 2–8 °C rule; it is not a model probability.
metricasIA.modoSombra: Shadow mode: it runs apart, not yet accepted. It does not open alerts.
metricasIA.matrizAyuda: Each row is the actual situation and each column is what the model assigned. The diagonal shows the correct calls.
metricasIA.matrizNotaCritica: Here a critical excursion appears as one more class in the evaluation. In operation it is confirmed by the 2–⁠8 °C rule, not by the model.
metricasIA.matrizNoDisponible: This evaluation does not include a complete matrix.
metricasIA.fraseSinValidar: A model that tries to anticipate risks. It is not validated yet and decides nothing: the 2–⁠8 °C rule decides.
metricasIA.fraseSinAceptar: A model that tries to anticipate risks. It is not accepted yet and decides nothing: the 2–⁠8 °C rule decides.
metricasIA.aciertoFrase: It got {{n}} out of 100 right in this example sample
metricasIA.aciertoFraseEvaluacion: It got {{n}} out of 100 right in the test evaluation

guia.descripcion: Everyday pharmacy questions, with the short answer and the screen where you solve them.

preventivo.descripcion: Near a limit. Check before it leaves the range.

critico.descripcion: Out of range. Check it and follow your procedure.

guia.rangoNota: Always compare with the reading date and time.
guia.pantallasDescripcion: Available links depend on your role.

historial.descripcion: Readings by device, risk and period.

integridad.descripcion: Record differences; does not replace official documents.

auditoria.descripcion: What actions happened and who did them.

rango.descripcion: Temperature limits configured for checking storage conditions on a device.

preventivo.descripcion: An alert that a reading is approaching a limit, even if it is still within range.

excursion.descripcion: A period when the temperature was outside the allowed range.

integridad.descripcion: A review that can flag later differences in related readings and actions.

bpa.descripcion: Good Storage Practices. The ColdCare checklist supports internal checks but does not certify compliance.

alerta.titulo: Does an alert confirm that medicine was damaged?
alerta.respuesta: No. ColdCare shows readings and refrigerator status; it cannot determine medicine condition on its own. Follow your pharmacy's procedure.

integridad.titulo: Does the integrity check replace official records?
integridad.respuesta: No. It can help flag differences in records, but it does not replace professional review or official documents.

metricas.titulo: Do these metrics show the current temperature?
metricas.respuesta: No. They summarize how a classifier performed on test cases; they do not show current temperatures or alerts.

permisos.titulo: Who can record what after a warning?
permisos.respuesta: Technical staff can record a corrective action; pharmacy staff can also mark an alert as reviewed. Audit is read-only.

guia.nota: Available screens depend on your role. Actions that change records also follow your system permissions.
guia.verMas: See all screens and other questions

alerta.pregunta: An alert went off, what do I do?
alerta.respuesta: Open Alerts and check the temperature and the time. Check the device, follow your pharmacy's procedure and write down what you did. An alert does not confirm a medicine was damaged: your procedure decides that.

bien.pregunta: How do I know everything is fine?
bien.respuesta: Look at Home: at the top it says whether everything is fine or which device to check, and the colour reads from afar. Tap a state to see how it looks.

anoche.respuesta: Open History and pick the date. The line shows every reading and marks in red whatever went outside 2–⁠8 °C, with its time.

constancia.pregunta: How do I get a certificate?
constancia.respuesta: Open Reports, pick the dates and the device, and download the sheet as a PDF. It is meant for internal reviews.

registros.respuesta: Open Check records: it looks for readings that changed after being saved. It helps detect it, but it does not replace an official document.

quien.respuesta: Open Audit: each action appears with the person, the day and the time.

equipo.pregunta: How do I register a new device?
equipo.respuesta: Open Devices and tap “Register device”. Copy the credential that appears: it is shown only once.

persona.pregunta: How do I give someone access?
persona.respuesta: Open Users and tap “New user”. Pick their role: it sets what they can see and do.

avisosTiempoReal.recuperacion: {{device}} is back in the safe range.
avisosTiempoReal.buffer_saturado: {{device}}'s reading memory is full: readings may have been lost.
avisosTiempoReal.wifi_reconexion_prolongada: {{device}} has been trying to reconnect to the network for a while.
avisosTiempoReal.config_modificada: {{device}}'s configuration was changed from its console ({{clave}}).
avisosTiempoReal.reinicio_manual: {{device}} was restarted manually from its console.
avisosTiempoReal.consola_desbloqueo_fallido: Repeated failed attempts to unlock {{device}}'s console.
avisosTiempoReal.ota_revertida: {{device}} rolled back to version {{version}}: the update failed its boot check.
avisosTiempoReal.excursion_no_verificada: Critical excursion of unverified origin on {{device}}: {{temperatura}} °C. Check the refrigerator with the backup thermometer.
avisosTiempoReal.monitoreo_suspendido: Monitoring of {{device}} suspended: compromise credential rotation.
avisosTiempoReal.sensor_fault: {{device}}'s temperature sensor is failing: the inside temperature is unknown.
avisosTiempoReal.colision_clave: {{device}} sent a reading with an identity already used and different values.
avisosTiempoReal.posesion_verificada: {{device}} proved the new credential: recording resumes.
avisosTiempoReal.posesion_firma_invalida: {{device}} is still on the previous token: the broker still accepts it. Change the password in the console and use "Resend challenge".
